workflow.name: archon-review
workflow.description:
Review a change through parallel specialist lenses and produce one evidence-based
verdict, held to the accepted contract (archon-review-block). Advisory and
read-only on the code: it judges, it never edits, and it posts its report to the
pull request as one canonical comment. When the verdict is Ready on a pull
request that is still a draft, the run pauses as one attention item instead of
ending with nothing to hand it on. The answer takes the pull request out of draft
for review and merge, or ends the run with the draft as it stands.

Use when: changes need judging — "review this PR", "review my changes",
"is this ready to merge".
NOT for: fixing findings (implement), running the project's checks (validate),
or writing code.

scope.description: What to review — a PR number/URL or a branch. Empty selects the current branch's open PR first, otherwise the working diff against the merge-base.

prior_report.description: Path to the previous review round's report. When set, this round verifies prior findings first and reviews only the delta since the commit that round reviewed, which its publish recorded beside the report.

work_order.description: The accepted outcome and scope boundaries for this change. Delivery passes the same work order implementation received. Standalone review may leave this empty and use the PR's problem, outcome, and explicit scope instead.

light.description: "true" when this continuation follows a correction for CI rather than for review: the general code lens alone reviews the delta.

part.description: The part of an approved multi-part plan this change delivers, as JSON naming the delivered part and each part's contract items, quoted: `{"delivers": 1, "parts": [{"part": 1, "items": ["..."]}, {"part": 2, "items": ["..."]}]}`. A contract item that only later parts list is deferred, not unmet. Empty reviews against the whole contract. The `mode` node's `output_format` owns and enforces the shape.

errors.description: Silent-failure lens — auto, true, or false.
